answers.workaround: Working around this is very clunky, requiring keeping a reference to the tween around, signalling whenever `Engine.time_scale` is updated, have the signal trigger an update function that will re-normalize the tween speed, and then clean up once the tween is finished or it won't be automatically freed. Very much goes against "set and forget" usage of tweens.

title: Add an option for tweens to ignore `Engine.time_scale`
